info.name: Vertex Markets API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Vertex Markets backend. Covers all modules including Authentication, Users, CMS, Markets, Platforms, Blog, Contact, Newsletter, Careers, Partners, Uploads, Dashboard, and Search.

## Authentication

This collection uses Bearer token authentication. After logging in via the Login endpoint, the `accessToken` response will be automatically saved to the `accessToken` collection variable and used for subsequent requests.

## Environment Variables

Create a Postman environment with the following variables:

- `baseUrl` - API base URL (e.g., http://localhost:3000)
- `accessToken` - JWT access token (auto-populated)
- `adminEmail` - Admin login email
- `adminPassword` - Admin login password
- `userId` - Sample user ID
- `marketId` - Sample market ID
- `platformId` - Sample platform ID
- `blogId` - Sample blog post ID
- `contactId` - Sample contact ID
- `newsletterId` - Sample newsletter subscriber ID
- `careerId` - Sample job ID
- `applicationId` - Sample application ID
- `partnerId` - Sample partner ID
- `referralId` - Sample referral ID
- `fileId` - Sample file ID
- `heroId` - Sample CMS hero section ID

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User authentication endpoints including register, login, logout, token refresh, password management, email verification, and profile updates.

request.description: Authenticate with email and password. Returns a JWT access token that will be automatically saved for subsequent requests.
Create a new user account. Returns user details and a verification token.
Logout by revoking the current refresh token.
Obtain a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Request a password reset. Returns a reset token in development.
Complete the password reset flow using the token from forgot-password.
Verify a user's email address using the verification token.
Change the password for the authenticated user.
Update the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Health check for the authentication service.

item.name: Users
item.description: User management endpoints. Self-service and admin operations.

request.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Partially update the authenticated user's own profile.
List all users. Requires Admin role.
Get a specific user by their ID.
Unblock a previously blocked user account.
Change the role of a user.
